abstracts.abstract: Enacts the "compulsory artificial narrative disclosure for official rhetoric (CANDOR) act" in relation to requiring any member of the senate or assembly that rises to speak, read a statement, or enter comments into the official legislative record to verbally state a standard disclosure prior to delivering such remarks if such remarks were drafted in whole or in part by artificial intelligence or generative artificial intelligence.

bill.title: Relates to the disclosure of artificial intelligence use in floor statements and debate by members of the legislature

posted_text:
🧠 AI, Data Centers & Crypto
NY S10692 — NY Law: Legislators Must Reveal AI-Generated Words

New York lawmakers will have to disclose when they've used artificial intelligence or generative AI to help write speeches or statements. If you hear a legislator speaking, and they’ve used AI to draft their remarks, they’re required to say something like, ‘The following remarks contain approximately [percentage] percent of artificial intelligence generated text. ...
